paper.title: Cobolt: integrative analysis of multimodal single-cell sequencing data
paper.version_read: Published article, 2021-12-28; Europe PMC XML PMC8715620.1 version1; publisher PDF21pages; Additional file2 Supplementary Methods3pages; acquired2026-10-19.

figure.scope: Whole original both panels with explicitly attributed Methods explanations; source numeric scatter/score marks represented as disclosed schematic roles, not reconstructed empirical coordinates.

scientific_question: How do paired and unpaired RNA/ATAC cells yield comparable latent representations while keeping neural inference distinct from probability-model generation and post-fit correction?

semantic_readback.inputs: Three cohorts with four observed matrices; same-cell rows in paired RNA/ATAC, distinct gene/peak feature spaces; unobserved modalities are not zeros.
semantic_readback.inference: log1p counts enter modality-specific neural encoders; per-cell posterior combines one prior with factors approximating posterior/prior ratios only for observed modalities.
semantic_readback.generation: Corresponding posterior draws feed modality-specific multinomial generative models without neural decoders; shared theta=softmax(z), feature and batch parameters; four original reconstruction roles retained.
semantic_readback.correction: Posterior means, distinct from draws, are mean-zero scaled. Paired cohort provides unimodal predictors and joint targets for separate RNA/ATAC XGBoost maps; apply maps to single-modality cohorts, retain paired joint reference.
semantic_readback.outputs: Common UMAP/Louvain roles; all point/grid positions schematic; observed-subset training includes selected subsets for paired cells.
semantic_readback.unknown: Supplement Eq5 prints alpha0 in scale and shift positions while Eq4/Eq6 distinguish scale alpha1; exact Eq5 and implementation unresolved. Centering axis and prime-output sampling convention not invented.

design.scope: Editable SVG text/vector primitives, vector PDF and PNG. Actual whole-page/zoom review; no target-journal-width print proof or arbitrary editor roundtrip.

Under the frozen full-dependency rubric, that is a correct core repair with a material synchronization omission.

Retain both judgments and do not pool their status counts as a comparable accuracy statistic.
